error.title: Recording unavailable
error.body: The recording is unavailable, may have been deleted, or has not been shared with you. Ask the meeting host to share access.

authentication.title: Authentication required
authentication.body: Please log in to access this recording.

unsaved.title: Download Unavailable
unsaved.body: This recording is not ready for download yet. Please try again later.

success.title: Your recording is ready!
success.expiration: Attention, this recording will expire after {{expiration_days}} day(s).

share.description: Give a teammate access to this recording. Share the page link with them and they can open and download it. Public links are not available.

error.invite: Could not add this person. Check that the email belongs to an existing user.
error.remove: Could not remove this person. Try again.
